ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
ወኢያቡሴዎን: ኢያቡሴዎን — and the Jebusites (ወ- 'and' + ethnic name, plural)
ወፌርዜዎን: ፌርዜዎን — and the Perizzites (ወ- 'and' + ethnic name, plural)
ወኤዌዎን: ኤዌዎን — and the Hivites (ወ- 'and' + ethnic name, plural)

ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ለዘርአ: ዘርእ — to the seed of (ለ- + noun, construct)
ባረኮ: ባረከ — he blessed him (3ms perfect, b-r-k + -ኦ 'him')
በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)

እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
እግዚአ: እግዚእ — lord (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · construct 'lord of' (እግዚአ ኵሉ 'Lord of all')
ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)

ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)

ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'

ገብአ: ገብአ — he returned (3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ሀገሩ: ሀገር — his city, 'the city of' (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለንጉሥ)
ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ቦአ: ቦአ — he entered (3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ፍሥሓ: ፍሥሓ — joy (construct 'joy of') · also the plain accusative 'joy' with an adjective (ኀብሩ ፍሥሓ ዐቢየ 'they joined in great joy')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
ሰማያዊያን: ሰማያዊ — heavenly ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city') · accusative of place 'in the city' (ይነብር ሀገረ 'he would stay in the city')

ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
ንግሥተ: ንግሥት — queen (noun, fem.; construct 'queen of' before the following noun)
ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)

ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ለወልዳ: ወልድ — her son (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
ወፈድፋደሰ: ፈድፋደ — and especially, and the more so
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ወነፍኁ: ነፍሐ — and they blew (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
በቅድሜሃ: ቅድሜ — before her (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- 'front' + -ሃ '3fs her')

ማክዳ: ማክዳ — Makeda (proper name, the Queen of Sheba)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ተፈሥሐት: ተፈሥሐ — rejoice, be glad (3fs perfect, T stem; subject ሀገር)
ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)

በእገሪሃ: እግር — with her feet (በ- + plural እገር + -ሃ '3fs her')
በመንፈስ: መንፈስ — by the spirit (በ- 'by, in' + noun; በመንፈስ ቅዱስ 'by the Holy Spirit')
ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
እብል: ብህለ — shall I say (1cs imperfect, b-h-l)
ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)

ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')

ዐቀብተ: ዐቃቢ — guards, guardians of (noun, plural ዐቀብት, construct)

በብዙኅ: ብዙኅ — with much (በ- + adjective, masc. sg.)
ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ወባቲ: በ — and by it, with it (ወ- + preposition በ + -ቲ '3fs', ባቲ)
ወብዕለ: ብዕል — and riches, wealth (ወ- + noun, accusative)
በውእቱ: ውእቱ — in that (በ- + demonstrative, before መዋዕል 'days')
ተውህበ: ወሀበ — it was given (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive)
ወአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and knowledge (ወ- + verbal noun of አእመረ)
ወሥነ: ሥን — and the beauty of (ወ- + noun 'beauty', construct accusative)
ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')
ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)
ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy') · nominative, collective 'an enemy' (ወይበልዕ ፀር እለ ኢታአምር 'an enemy you do not know will eat')
አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
ወ፼: ፼ — and 10,000, spoken ወትእልፍት (wä-təʾəlfət) 'and ten thousand' (ወ- + numeral; spoken form uncertain) (?)
፲፻: ፲፻ — 1000, spoken ዐሠርቱ ምእት (ʿäśärtu məʾət) 'ten hundred, a thousand' (numeral)
ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
ቆሮስ: ቆሮስ — kor (a large dry measure; Hebrew kor) (noun)
በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
ዘበሕጉ: ሕግ — what is by his law (ዘ- 'that which' + በ- 'by' + ሕግ 'law' + -ሁ 'his', contracted -ጉ)
